title: Gravity A and gravity B in Barry's lab notes

tellings.quote: Barry had um, other lab notes, Mhm. and I don't know if those were previous docu- or documents that he had, but they were lab notes, and these this was the direction they were going in at one time.

plain: At S4, a secret site in Nevada where he says alien craft were studied in the late 1980s, a colleague named Barry Castilio is said to have had lab notes about two kinds of gravity, labelled gravity A and gravity B. Bob Lazar, who says he worked there, tells it, saying the notes showed "the direction they were going in at one time," though he does not know where the notes came from. It would show how the team thought the craft were powered.
